headline: Binance Completes Withdrawal Recovery Work Following Crypto Heist
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance announced that its withdrawal recovery work has been completed following a $6.3 billion crypto heist.
why: Security breaches and subsequent recovery operations on major cryptocurrency exchanges affect user trust and platform liquidity.

impacts.name: Cryptocurrency market
impacts.why: Resolution of a major platform's withdrawal freeze affects broader crypto liquidity and market confidence.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
